name: valve_ep2_cache_cave
note: Episode Two's little cave by the road (ep2_outland_10, the radar cache with the lambda, the skeletons and two footlockers): its rock skin (five walls of cliff02a, a roof, the floor under its south half, all displaced) and its things; open on its north-east, a mouth 180 wide between the north wall's end and the east wall's. Anchor: the middle of the mouth on the floor. The floor under its north half and the cliff round the mouth belong to the hillside outside and are not in it.
